subject: Stratify customer spotlight: packaging, approvals, and embargo plan
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@stratify.co>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Simon Lee <simon.lee@stratify.co>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood customer spotlight opportunity

Hi Vivek / Laura —

Thanks for the outreach and the opportunity to be featured. We are excited about the joint announcement window we discussed on the call. A couple quick questions so we can align internally: 

- Our preferred launch window is April 25–27 PT. Can Redwood hold the embargo until 09:00 PT on April 25?
- We need a short (1–2 sentence) approved quote to sign off on — is April 18 EOD a feasible deadline?
- Legal will want a simple reference consent and a redline-friendly draft of the press package.

I can circulate a short internal checklist and our comms lead (Simon) will help with logos and a preferred byline.

Appreciate the help — Ellen

Ellen Park
Head of Product Marketing
Stratify, Inc.
ellen.park@stratify.co
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@stratify.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood customer spotlight opportunity

Hi Ellen —

Great — that window works for us and we can hold the embargo until 09:00 PT on April 25. Proposed timeline / asks below so everyone is aligned:

1) By April 18 EOD: Final approved quote (1–2 sentences), logo (PNG + SVG), and a 150–200 word spotlight blurb.
2) April 19–21: Redwood to share the press package draft and one-pager for final sign-off.
3) April 22–24: Final legal/marketing checks and DocuSign for reference consent; we will not distribute to media before 25 at 09:00 PT.

Attachments: I’m attaching the current one-pager (redwood_press_onepager_v1.pdf) and a working press package outline so Laura/Legal have something to start from.

If Laura or Ben want to suggest edits to the calendar, happy to iterate — otherwise we’ll treat the dates above as the working plan.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@stratify.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood customer spotlight opportunity

Ellen —

Thanks, this is helpful. Two quick notes from legal/ops: 

- I’ve attached the reference_consent_template.pdf — please confirm with your legal team if any redlines are needed. We prefer DocuSign for signatures (link will come from Ben once we have the final quote).
- Attached press_package_draft.docx contains the suggested headline, bullets, and media contact language. We kept the quote placeholder generic; once you send the exact wording we’ll slot it in.

Also: can we book a 20-minute sync for April 20 at 10:00 PT to run through the final flow and who will be the Redwood press contact on distribution?

Laura Bennett
Head of Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@stratify.co>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Simon Lee <simon.lee@stratify.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood customer spotlight opportunity

Hi all —

Quick update from Stratify: Simon and I have the internal approvals in process and we’re able to provide the quote below. We’re also attaching the high-res logo and a short background paragraph.

Approved quote (please use exactly): "Redwood’s inference platform has helped us reduce latency by over 40% in production, making conversational features feel instant for our customers."

Attachments: stratify_logo_rgb.png, stratify_quote_approved.txt (quote text), stratify_spotlight_bio.txt (150 words).

On the embargo: we can confirm embargo until 2027-04-25 09:00 PT, and yes, please notify press on distribution — we typically expect a single point of contact and an embargo notice in the email.

One more ask: can Redwood share a short list of target outlets so we can ensure there are no conflicts with our other PR plans?

Thanks — Ellen
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@stratify.co>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood customer spotlight opportunity

Thanks Ellen — great to have the approved quote and assets. Next steps on our side: 

- I’ll generate the DocuSign envelope using the reference_consent_template and route to Simon + Ellen for signature today (DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Member/ABCDEF123456).
- Redwood will prepare a target outlet list and share by EOD Apr 15 (we generally include TechLedger, CloudBeat, and two trade outlets; I’ll circulate the draft list).
- We plan a targeted distribution at 09:00 PT on Apr 25 and will provide embargoed copies to Silverline PR and our top-tier contacts the morning of the embargo lift.

Attachments in this thread are placeholders — once signed we’ll swap in final assets to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-press-pack

If anyone wants to tweak the distribution cadence (e.g., partner-only preview), say so before EOD Apr 15.

Ben Carter
Senior Director, Partnerships (Sales)
ben_carter@redwood.ai
